Pickaxe is a wonderful platform that allows anybody and everybody to make their own AI applications without needing to learn how to code. This puts power into the hands of the ordinary person to build the AI tools they'll need for everyday tasks and save themselves time and money. For example you can build an AI tool that tells you how strong your logline or pitch is, if you are a screenwriter like myself. Or if you want an AI Tool that can help you calculate how much of each ingredient you'll need for a recipe that serves 10 people instead of just 6, Pickaxe has you covered. Pickaxe will help you build the tools you'll need to succeed in the modern day world where AI is advancing all the time.

#### What's great [...] Image 13: Anno Torr

Anno Torr

•1 review

I've been a Gold Pickaxe member since July 3 and I absolutely love it. So easy to use, the generated answers are extremely good, but for my purposes, what I especially love is the ability to hide my prompts, embed them on a website behind a paywall, AND still provide the pickaxe users with the option to engage in a chat with the AI to refine the output!! Seriously a game-changer. Just one comment though; in my industry of online course creators (and this is a huge industry), having the option to include the users' voice style and tone in the prompt is essential and I would love to have that feature included in the Gold level. Well done, Mike, Nathaniel, and Team, an excellent product.
